text: My office has received communications from residents expressing concerns regarding traffic congestion and safety around the area of Bathurst Street and Cortleigh Boulevard. The existing three-hour parking limit in front of the daycare results in long-term parking that significantly limits drop-off and pick-up activity. Prohibiting parking in this area to facilitate a kiss and ride would increase drop-off and pick-up capacity. The proposed one-hour limit, east of the daycare will provide short-term parking for parents. The proposed stopping prohibition opposite the daycare and the proposed parking prohibition in front of Cortleigh Parkette will promote safe and efficient two-way traffic.

North York Community Council: 1. Approved a one-hour maximum parking limit, in effect from 7:30 a.m. to 9:00 a.m. and 3:30 p.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the north side of Cortleigh Boulevard, between a point 91.5 metres east of Bathurst Street and a point 49.5 metres further east. 2. Prohibited parking from 7:30 a.m. to 9:00 a.m. and 3:30 p.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the north side of Cortleigh Boulevard, between Bathurst Street and a point 91.5 metres further east. 3. Prohibited stopping from 7:30 a.m. to 9:00 a.m. and 3:30 p.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the south side of Cortleigh Boulevard, between Bathurst Street and a point 91.5 metres further east. 4.
